items.title: File Widerspruch against Gefahrklasse assessment
items.quote: Den Widerspruch können Sie binnen eines Monats ab Bekanntgabe einlegen, schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei der Musterbau-Berufsgenossenschaft, Gerüstweg 7, 30159 Musterhannover.
items.computation: Letter dated Thu 19.11.2026; assumed posted same day. The letter states the Bekanntgabe fiction applies on the 4th day after posting (consistent with the current §37 Abs.2 SGB X standard of 4 days, in force since the 2025 postal-law reform). Counting from 19.11. (posting day not counted): day1=20.11(Fri), day2=21.11(Sat), day3=22.11(Sun), day4=23.11.2026 (Mon) = Bekanntgabe date (a weekday, no adjustment needed). The one-month Widerspruchsfrist runs from this event; per §188 Abs.2 BGB the period ends on the day in the following month bearing the same number as the day of the triggering event, i.e. 23.12.2026. 23.12.2026 is a Wednesday and not a public holiday in NRW, so no further shift under §193 BGB is required.
